subject: paper:arildskov-2020-factor-structure

subject: paper:toplak-2013
quote: Only 68 (24%) of the 286 relevant correlations reported in these studies were statistically significant, and the overall median correlation was only .19.
rationale: Verified against author-hosted full text; the two instrument families measuring the 'same' construct barely converge — method variance dominates.

subject: paper:sonuga-barke-2010
quote: For ADHD patients, the co-occurrence of inhibitory, temporal processing and delay-related deficits was no greater than expected by chance with substantial groups of patients showing only one problem.
rationale: Verified via the ERIC full abstract; the mechanistic components are statistically independent — the core orthogonality-at-the-mechanism-level result.

subject: paper:nigg-2005
quote: future theory and research give more consideration to the probability that only a subset of behaviorally defined children will have a deficit in a given neurocognitive mechanism believed to contribute to the disorder.
rationale: Verified against fetched text; the corollary of dissociability — no single mechanism is universal, so several must be sampled.

subject: paper:kofler-2013
quote: children/adolescents (Hedges' g = 0.76) and adults (g = 0.46) with ADHD demonstrated greater RT variability relative to TD groups.
rationale: Verified against the FSU full-text PDF; establishes RT variability as a robust, heavily replicated ADHD marker.

subject: paper:kofler-2013
quote: Comparison with clinical control groups reveals that RT variability is not specific to ADHD.
rationale: Verified full text; the mandatory caution — even the most robust task marker cannot discriminate ADHD from other clinical conditions, so no single measure is diagnostic.

subject: paper:nichols-2004
quote: the CPT, C-DT, and the SST had the most support, yet further efforts to evaluate the validity of these measures are needed before they can be used for more than experimental purposes.
rationale: Verified against SpringerLink; even the best-supported cognitive tasks are not validated for clinical decision-making.

subject: paper:hall-2016
quote: There were mixed findings with regard to the use of CPTs to assess and manage medication, with contrasting evidence on their ability to support clinical decision-making.
rationale: Verified against the Springer record; systematic review shows the leading objective measure is not decisive on its own.

subject: paper:hall-cohen-kadosh-2023-rating-review
quote: Although behavioural rating scales should not be relied upon solely to clinically diagnose adult ADHD, they are often regarded as a valuable tool in research settings.
rationale: Verified full text (preprint); the rating side of the same point — scales alone are not diagnostic, multi-method is needed.

subject: paper:chadd-diagnosing
quote: There is no single test to diagnose ADHD. Therefore, a comprehensive evaluation is necessary to establish a diagnosis, rule out other causes, and determine the presence or absence of co-existing conditions.
rationale: Verified against the CHADD page; the plainest statement of the multi-method conclusion, and the direct guidance for the personal next clinical step.

subject: paper:hyseni-2021-hitop-latent
quote: Below this are six spectra (somatoform, internalizing, thought disorder, disinhibited externalizing, antagonistic externalizing, and detachment).
rationale: Verified full text; specifies the HiTOP spectra under which ADHD's dimensions (IA, HY, IMP) sit — the measurement-level realisation of the nosology axis.
